name: Security Guard
text: Stop! You need an ID or an allotment form to enter the college.

name: Player
text: I'm here for admission. I was told to report to the college today.

name: Security Guard
text: I understand, but I can't let you in without an ID or the allotment form.

name: Player
text: I don't have either of them with me right now. Is there any other way I can enter?

name: Security Guard
text: No. You'll need to get your allotment form first.

name: Player
text: Where can I get the allotment form?

name: Security Guard
text: There's a cyber cafe nearby. They should be able to help you get a copy of your allotment form.

name: Player
text: Alright. I'll go to the cyber cafe and get the form.

name: Security Guard
text: Once you have it, come back here and show it to me. Then you can enter.

name: Player
text: Got it. I'll be back with the allotment form.
